claim.scope_statement:
Proves the proposed concentrated-scalar largest-root extremizer for every homogeneous hyperbolic polynomial of degree three, with arbitrary ambient dimension, closed hyperbolicity cone, number of directions and feasible trace cap. Provides the exact optimal cubic root and an attaining tuple consisting of interior scalar directions and zero vectors. It does not resolve degree four or higher, characterize all maximizers, or assert global priority.

Significance relative to the checked source: Directly resolves the degree-three class of the original interior-or-zero extremizer problem, beyond the previous repository attempt's single degree-two product polynomial. The proof works without a determinantal representation and supplies the scalar-direction conclusion beyond already-known trace concentration.
